forbidden_claims: TRIAXIS invented provenance or assurance cases
TRIAXIS invented stop/reopen or value-of-computation control
TRIAXIS invented adversarial verifier audit trails
adjudication.permitted_claim_now: The project may claim measured controller effects only where frozen prospective experiments show them (for example, prospective detection of verifier-contract mismatches).
adjudication.reason: Every broad primitive in the current EBRC formulation has strong antecedents in established agent commitment/reconsideration, metareasoning, provenance, assurance-case, dynamic-assurance, and agent-verifier/audit-trail work.
adjudication.surviving_research_wedge: Treat TRIAXIS/EBRC as an empirically testable integration/control architecture: synchronized state/evidence binding + verifier semantic-contract validation + selective external verification + bounded commitment/reopen/stop + immutable receipts.

link_to_r10a.interpretation: R10-A supports a concrete procedural controller effect (prospective instrument-validity detection) and should be reported as such, not as novelty.

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for commitment strategies, runtime reconsideration, or environment-conditioned reconsideration.
prior_art_matrix.source: Schut & Wooldridge, Principles of Intention Reconsideration (Agents 2001), DOI 10.1145/375735.376326

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for deciding when to terminate computation or allocate reasoning.
prior_art_matrix.source: Callaway et al., Learning to select computations (2017)

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for selective reasoning based on Value of Computation.

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for provenance graphs, derivation chains, primary-source binding, revision, or delegation semantics.

prior_art_matrix.ebrc_component: claim supported by structured evidence and defeater analysis
prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for evidence-to-claim assurance arguments or confidence via identified/eliminated defeaters.

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for continual reevaluation of assurance evidence as environment/system state changes.
prior_art_matrix.source: NASA NTRS, Dynamic Assurance of Autonomous Systems (2023/2024)

prior_art_matrix.implication: Do not claim novelty for integrating adversarial verifiers into agent workflows or machine-readable audit trails mapping decisions to evidence.
